\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-08},
  title = {The model is baked into the API image},
  date = {2026-09-22},
  milestone = {M4: Model Deployment},
  topic = {ML System Design},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {CI builds the API image with the production model inside, fetched with \texttt{dvc pull} at the state \texttt{dvc.\allowbreak{}lock} on \texttt{main} points to.
Promoting a model is a merge to \texttt{main}.
The API never calls the MLflow registry; MLflow stays the record of the experiments and of the run that was promoted.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Pull from the MLflow registry at API startup: startup then depends on DagsHub being reachable, against NFR-05 and NFR-12.
\item CD resolves the registry alias and bakes the model on promotion: needs a trigger from MLflow to GitHub Actions that nobody would watch.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The course demo deploys by pulling the model with DVC before it starts the server, and we do the same in a container.
GitHub Flow, already our branching model, becomes the promotion mechanism, so there is no new infrastructure to build or to fail before a presentation.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI first recommended the registry-alias option.
Asked whether that fits the project's scope, it read \texttt{references/\allowbreak{}course-\allowbreak{}demos.\allowbreak{}md}, found that the demo pulls with DVC, and revised its recommendation, naming the cost: the MLflow registry leaves the deployment path.
Lukas confirmed the revised option.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-09-22, review of PR \#19; Lukas asked: ``considering our project scope and the tools we will use is this the best option for us?''.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/specification.md}{Specification} FR-12, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/project-brief.md}{project brief} section 5, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/references/course-demos.md}{course demo notes}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/19}{PR \#19}.},
}
